goal_residuals.summary: Implement and prove public fresh-page activation, compatible authority refusal and zero replay/network/mutation; all twelve warm-open tests currently fail on openType undefined.
Prove Vite build after recreated open; dependency edits/extra/deletions and source survive; explicit retained-cache repair and post-repair build remain downstream GREEN targets.

Complete unreadable-preload honesty and claim persistence failure refusal across recreated open. Existing install/build flush-result fix is outside this preparation and must remain linked to its accepted final proof.
Implement installer-only durable byte/directory equality and prove dirty/unknown/empty/pending healing without generic fs behavior changes.
Implement single traversal/root initialization sharing; preserve native behavior and eager exact bytes. Independent baseline remains root=2,directory=24,fileHandle=8,getFile=16; concurrent roots=12.
Record final repeat boot/install native counts separately from elapsed time and complete end-to-end invariant proof before closing goal.
